meta.title: Economics articles: tables and claims
meta.tagline: The regression tables and the claims of the same papers, two linked datasets, one process: uploaded from the pipeline, checked against each other, reviewed paper by paper, released together.
meta.description: One workflow over two datasets of the Robustness-at-Scale pipeline: every new paper's tables and claims files enter the group together, each side is re-checked against its contract, the printed cells against each other, the cited estimates against the paper's own tables, the claims' concepts are harmonised into corpus edges, and a joint review walks both sides of each paper before the two datasets are released as one.

authors.affiliation: University of Basel; University of Copenhagen

steps.label: Number check
steps.help: every standard error names its coefficient, the parsed number is the printed one, stars agree with the level and the p-value, t with coefficient over se, the stated N with the printed N

steps.label: Estimates against the tables
steps.help: each cited point estimate against the coefficient cells of the same paper's tables (the group's tables dataset); a resolved column with no matching cell is an error, an exhibit no column matches a warning

steps.label: Corpus edges
steps.help: one row per (cause, effect) concept pair across the corpus: a model call maps each claim's wording to a shared concept, a deterministic merge groups the claims into edges with their majority sign and the studies behind them
